content: ContextMesh is a multi-platform AI workflow continuity context governance platform for AI-heavy individuals and small teams.
The project is for Bluebridge Cup digital technology application innovation.
The product core is a self-designed Context Governance Engine, not MemOS, jstarctl, or a wrapper around a third-party memory framework.

The platform scope includes domestic and overseas AI tools, including Tongyi Qianwen, Alibaba Bailian, Doubao, Kimi, Wenxin, Zhipu, Tencent Yuanbao, Tongyi Lingma, CodeGeeX, Comate, Trae, MarsCode, GPT, Gemini, and Claude.
The first value path should use real cases and source-bound claims rather than invented teams or fake timelines.
The first value path should preserve audit logs, artifacts, and WCEF reports as evidence.
